day_shape: 54 items: CENTCOM says naval blockade on Iran redirected 12 vessels and disabled 2, Trump reportedly paused strikes citing Patriot interceptor stockpiles, Iran-Oman Hormuz talks show 'some progress', heavy IRIB/Defa Press cycle around Akbar Abdi funeral and Hormozgan cleanup, nothing from UK Parliament or IAEA.

threads.label: US pause on Iran strikes and blockade
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported Trump paused further strikes on Iran while talks continue, with US officials citing concern over Patriot interceptor stockpiles, while CENTCOM said its naval blockade had redirected 12 vessels, disabled 2 and boarded 2 as of 25 July. Defa Press amplified a New York Times account of the pause and the Iranian Army spokesman claimed US infrastructure in Erbil had been 'almost completely destroyed'.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz and Iran-Oman talks
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported 'some progress' in Iran-Oman talks on Strait of Hormuz navigation, and Foreign Ministry spokesman Baghaei told Defa Press that several rounds of deputy-level talks were held in Tehran but no change had occurred in transit conditions. Regime channels quoted parliamentarian Borjerdei and an IRIB correspondent asserting Iranian control over the 240,000-sq-km Persian Gulf.

threads.label: IDF strikes on Hamas operatives in Gaza
threads.summary: The IDF and Times of Israel military correspondent Emanuel Fabian said strikes last week killed Hamas weapons-production department head Fares Al-Masri, Nukhba cell commander Muhannad Abu Ghazal who took part in the 7 October Kissufim raid, and further Hamas operatives. The IDF said Al-Masri had been involved in rebuilding Hamas weapons capabilities 'in violation of the ceasefire'.

threads.label: Khamenei message on funeral and America
threads.summary: Khamenei's office published a message thanking a 'historic tens-of-millions presence' in Iran and Iraq at the funeral of the 'Fighting Imam Martyr', including a separate gratitude message to Iraqis. Excerpts said 'bullying, hegemony and savagery are inherent components of the creed and approach of America'.

threads.label: Post-strike cleanup and homefront in Iran
threads.summary: IRIB and Defa Press reported controlled detonation of unexploded ordnance in Bandar Abbas, south Isfahan and Pakadasht from the 'third imposed war', and Hormozgan's Chief Justice claimed all damaged tunnels, bridges and routes had reopened ahead of schedule. Regime channels also flagged a heatwave with 33 stations above 45°C and the closure of Mazandaran offices.

events.title: Two more Hamas operatives were killed in Israeli strikes in the Gaza Strip last week, the military announces. According to the IDF, one strike in the Strip's north on Tuesday killed Fares al-Masri, a commander in Hamas's weapons production division. The military says al-Masri was involved in "the production of weapons as part of Hamas's efforts to rebuild its capabilities, in violation of the ceasefire agreement." Another strike in northern Gaza on Tuesday killed Mohammad Abu Shakian, a member of Hamas's elite Nukhba Force, according to the IDF. The IDF says both operatives worked to advance attacks on troops and Israeli civilians, and they were killed to "remove the threat."
